dict.string: LV24 WiFi Explorer needs Location Services because macOS treats Wi-Fi SSID and BSSID as location-class data. This helper does not use GPS and does not read, store, or display coordinates.
LV24 WiFi Explorer uses Location (When In Use) only so CoreWLAN can return SSID and BSSID. Apple classifies those identifiers as location-class data. We do not use GPS.
